name: aurikat-monorepo
description: AuriKat — Monorepo hexagonal modular con segregación estricta App del Niño vs. Portal Clínico (Beta v1.0)

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core-engine packages/clinical-envelope packages/clinical-scoring apps/player apps/clinical
scripts.build:player: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace=@aurikat/player run build
scripts.build:clinical: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace=@aurikat/clinical run build
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace=@aurikat/player run build && npm --workspace=@aurikat/clinical run build && npm run verify:segregation
